rows.candidateRo: Lucrul acesta a rămas de atunci și până în ziua de azi o lege și un obicei în Israel.
rows.WEBU: It was so from that day forward that he made it a statute and an ordinance for Israel to this day.

rows.candidateRo: Când s-a întors la Țiclag, David a trimis o parte din pradă bătrânilor lui Iuda, prietenilor săi, spunându-le aceste cuvinte: „Iată darul pe care vi-l fac din prada luată de la vrăjmașii DOMNULUI!”
rows.WEBU: When David came to Ziklag, he sent some of the plunder to the elders of Judah, even to his friends, saying, “Behold, a present for you from the plunder of the LORD’s enemies.”

rows.candidateRo: A trimis celor din Betel, celor din Ramot de la miazăzi, celor din Iatir,
rows.WEBU: He sent it to those who were in Bethel, to those who were in Ramoth of the South, to those who were in Jattir,

rows.candidateRo: celor din Aroer; celor din Sifmot, celor din Eștemoa,
rows.WEBU: to those who were in Aroer, to those who were in Siphmoth, to those who were in Eshtemoa,

rows.candidateRo: celor din Racal, celor din cetățile ierahmeeliților, celor din cetățile cheniților,
rows.WEBU: to those who were in Racal, to those who were in the cities of the Jerahmeelites, to those who were in the cities of the Kenites,

rows.candidateRo: celor din Horma, celor din Cor-Așan, celor din Atac,
rows.WEBU: to those who were in Hormah, to those who were in Borashan, to those who were in Athach,

rows.candidateRo: celor din Hebron și în toate locurile pe care le străbătuse David cu oamenii lui.
rows.WEBU: to those who were in Hebron, and to all the places where David himself and his men used to stay.
